channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about De'Aaron Fox | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about De'Aaron Fox from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Devin Vassell on De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Devin Vassell on #Spurs' three-guard starting lineup:

“You don't know who to pick up. It's Fox, it's Dylan, it's Steph. We have five ball handlers that can come down and attack the basket and make a play. I think it's going to be tough for other teams.”

Devin Vassell on De'Aaron Fox, Oct 15, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Brian Wright on De'Aaron Fox, Dylan Harper
item.description:
More from Brian Wright on Dylan Harper and De'Aaron Fox:

“They're are a tough matchup. We'll continue to put them in situations for them to be at their best... They'll learn from this year on how they continue to play off one another and support one another and go from there.”

Brian Wright on De'Aaron Fox, Dylan Harper, Jun 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Patrick Beverley:

“I think D'Aaron Fox was trash. I think he was god-awful. And I don't think that was because of him. I think because he was injured a little bit. I think the coach should have had him come off the bench and kind of went with what he had against OKC. I didn't like him just putting him in the starting lineup. But you live and you learn, and that's the difference between good coaches and elite coaches. There's no disrespect to coach Mitch, but elite coaches would have put D'Aaron Fox on the bench, let him get his rhythm, and went with what they had.”

Patrick Beverley on De'Aaron Fox, Jun 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Free throws, De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Legion Hoops:Magic Johnson on De'Aaron Fox:

“He should’ve pulled the ball back out… I think that play really hurt the Spurs. Wemby’s two free throws he missed hurt the spurs. De’Aaron is a point guard, you gotta know every situation. My job as a point guard was to know every situation.”

Magic Johnson on Free throws, De'Aaron Fox, Jun 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mitch Johnson on De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Mitch Johnson:

“I don't get into social media. I think I've probably been fired 212 times, and we've traded Fox 72 times. People have their opinions. I don't care. De'Aaron Fox will have the ball in his hands at the end of the game tomorrow and I have nothing but the utmost confidence that he's gonna deliver like he's done countless times for us”

Mitch Johnson on De'Aaron Fox, Jun 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mitch Johnson on De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Spurs coach Mitch Johnson, on De’Aaron Fox’s comments that the team has been inconvenienced by the president attending Game 3:

“I have not felt any inconvenience. We have a big game tonight, and trying to continue to find a way to play closer to the standard and our identity than we have in the first two games. There’s a lot going on, and I’d much rather be part of it than not.”

Mitch Johnson on De'Aaron Fox, Jun 8, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mitch Johnson on De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Mitch Johnson on De’Aaron Fox:

“We’re at our best when he's confident, in attack mode and has the basketball in his hands,making his teammates better and making plays for himself.”

Mitch Johnson on De'Aaron Fox, Jun 5, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Mitch Johnson on De'Aaron Fox, Dylan Harper
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:No update from Mitch Johnson on De'Aaron Fox and Dylan Harper after their game efforts to play through obvious pain:

“I'm sure they're beat up. They're giving us everything they got. So it's commendable just the fight that they have... So just tip the cap and ask as much as they can give.”

Mitch Johnson on De'Aaron Fox, Dylan Harper, May 23, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on De'Aaron Fox, Dylan Harper
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't:Wemby on Fox and Harper not being 100%:

“It pains me to see them in pain. I trust that they're going to be healthy soon and come back. They should take care of their health. Like we did game 1, we're gonna have their back”

Victor Wembanyama on De'Aaron Fox, Dylan Harper, May 23, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Mitch Johnson on De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Tom Orsborn‬: Mitch Johnson on Wemby and Fox combining for just 21 points and going a combined 0 of 12 from deep:

“They'll be better. We'll be better for them. There's some things that we can do execution-wise that will be a lot better.”

Mitch Johnson on De'Aaron Fox, May 5, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on De'Aaron Fox, Jaden McDaniels
item.description:
‪Jon Krawczynski‬:Anthony Edwards on Jaden McDaniels, who had 3 blocks at the rim and held De'Aaron Fox to 6-19 shooting:

“He’s my favorite player in the NBA.I don’t care if he have 2 points. I don’t care if he have 30 points. The way he affect the game in so many ways, he’s by far my favorite player for sure.”

Anthony Edwards on De'Aaron Fox, Jaden McDaniels, Jan 12, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Paul Pierce, De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Kevin Garnett:

“I like the young Spurs. They look good, bro. Dylan look good. Paul Pierce: They should look to get a trade for D Fox. I mean, I like the core with the young. I just like the young guys. I like the lineup of the guys that’s around the same age to grow together.”

Kevin Garnett on Paul Pierce, De'Aaron Fox, Oct 25, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Wembanyama laughed again as he revealed what he'd heard.

“De'Aaron draws the foul. He (the Wizards player) goes to his teammate, ‘He asked me to pick him up full court. Doesn't he know him?'”

Victor Wembanyama on De'Aaron Fox, Feb 11, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Devin Vassell on De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Jeff McDonald:More Vassell on how Fox's addition changes things for Spurs:

“I think we’re going to play a lot faster. We’re going to play in transition a lot. It’s going to open up a lot. Fox and Wemby having a screen and roll, who do you stop between them two? ... It’s going to be exciting.”

Devin Vassell on De'Aaron Fox, Feb 3, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Mitch Johnson on De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
“When you add a player like De'Aaron Fox and you already have a strong foundation, there will be opinions and expectations that come with that, what that means, what the timeline is. We'll get into that, but we will not shy away from the reality of adding good players and things that come with that.”

Mitch Johnson on De'Aaron Fox, Feb 3, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Monte McNair on De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
“De'Aaron has played a pivotal role with our franchise, and we are deeply grateful for everything he did to support the organization on and off the court,”

Monte McNair on De'Aaron Fox, Feb 3, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
“It’s tough because looking at the landscape before I came here those were the guys I talked to, Fox, Domantas, and Malik,”

DeMar DeRozan on De'Aaron Fox, Jan 30, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Domantas Sabonis on De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
“Doug changed our defense and gave more freedom on offense for me, Fox, and DeMar to play our game. We create something, and the others play off of the situations we create,”

Domantas Sabonis on De'Aaron Fox, Jan 14, 2025. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Doug Christie on DeMar DeRozan, Domantas Sabonis, De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Kings interim head coach Doug Christie:

“Part of my job is to get the heck out of the way and let (Fox, Sabonis, DeRozan) do what they do.”

Doug Christie on DeMar DeRozan, Domantas Sabonis, De'Aaron Fox, Dec 30, 2024. Source: Twitter @MattGeorgeSAC.

item.title: LeBron James on Domantas Sabonis, De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
“He could change them, and they might have the kind assets to make a trade work. They have a lot of young talent, and because they’re a small market, they haven’t spent like drunken sailors. They have some draft picks a young talent. If they could get to the salary, LeBron would take (De’Aron) Fox and (Domantas) Sabonis and elevate the hell out of them — particularly Fox. With that threesome, those guys could be a force.”

LeBron James on Domantas Sabonis, De'Aaron Fox, Dec 12, 2024. Source: Heavy.com.

item.title: Keon Ellis on De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
If Ellis can prove to be worthy of a top-seven rotational role down the stretch, that provides an extra level of flexibility as Sacramento reconstructs for the future.

“Icome in. I know I’m not going to be the De’Aaron Fox of the team,”

Keon Ellis on De'Aaron Fox, Apr 4, 2024. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Josh Hart on De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Fred Katz:Josh Hart on the Knicks' strong defense on De'Aaron Fox:

“I was about to say, ‘Not me.’ That boy spun me around like a top.”

Josh Hart on De'Aaron Fox, Mar 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Luguentz Dort on De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Lu Dort on guarding De’Aaron Fox:

“Pretty tough. He’s a good guard. He’s fast. Just make it tough for him. Especially after a game like yesterday where I feel like I didn’t do my job right.”

Luguentz Dort on De'Aaron Fox, Feb 11, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on OKC’s defense on De’Aaron Fox:

“Thought Lu did a good job on him. In the first half especially. He’s gotten loose against us.. He’s given us a lot of trouble in the past.”

Mark Daigneault on De'Aaron Fox, Feb 11, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mike Brown on Domantas Sabonis, De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Kings coach Mike Brown told Andscape.

“They are playing at an unbelievably elite level, Domantas establishing historic numbers with his double-doubles and De’Aaron setting a new career mark for 3-point field goals. Every year, there are deserving players left off the team but, to me, this is truly a glaring wrongdoing.”

Mike Brown on Domantas Sabonis, De'Aaron Fox, Feb 1, 2024. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Steve Kerr on De'Aaron Fox, Moses Moody
item.description:
After the game, Steve Kerr defended his decision by saying that the Warriors needed to slow down Kings star De'Aaron Fox in the clutch, opting to go with more experienced defenders Andrew Wiggins and Klay Thompson to try and achieve that goal.

“We needed to get Wiggs on the floor for defense against Fox. And we decided to go with Klay and our vets. We thought about keeping [Moses Moody] out there, but we made the move that we made,”

Steve Kerr on De'Aaron Fox, Moses Moody, Nov 29, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Mike Brown on De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Kings coach Mike Brown said after the win.

“Being able to shoot the ball like that, score from the other two levels as strong as he is — quick, athletic, intelligent, there’s nothing that will surprise me. “The only thing that surprises me is every list I see on these MVP things, I don’t see (Fox’s) name on it at all. … Now that amazes me. That surprises me, that I don’t see his name mentioned on that list at all. Even when you start talking about lead guards, his name’s not mentioned. I don’t have an answer for that one, but I know it’s wrong.”

Mike Brown on De'Aaron Fox, Nov 19, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: LeBron James on Mike Brown, De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Jason Anderson:LeBron James on the Sacramento Kings:

“They got the reigning Coach of the Year. I know what Mike Brown is all about, being able to play for him for many years and then just seeing his growth... And D. Fox, he's getting better and better. So, they got a really good franchise.”

LeBron James on Mike Brown, De'Aaron Fox, Oct 30, 2023. Source: Twitter @JandersonSacBee.

item.title: Keegan Murray on De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Keegan Murray:

“It was just being around the facility and around a lot of our guys. We had a lot of guys staying in Sacramento. So we were competing every day. Obviously, Fox was there so I was able to build a connection with him off the court. That was really cool. I feel like I progressed a lot with being in Sacramento and being with our coaches.”

Keegan Murray on De'Aaron Fox, Oct 12, 2023. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Domantas Sabonis on De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Fox and Sabonis became the first Kings teammates named All-NBA in the same season since Oscar Robertson and Jerry Lucas in 1967-68, both as Third Team selections, both for the first time in their careers.

“There’s a lot of trust in me in this franchise for Fox and I to lead and we’re excited,”

Domantas Sabonis on De'Aaron Fox, Oct 6, 2023. Source: Sacramento Bee.
